metadata.title: Special handmade steam noodles by Haittee woman | हाटी महिला के हाथ से बने रागी सुतोले
metadata.description: The Hattee tribe of trans giri area still practice traditional form of agriculture and grow many traditional millets on the hill slops. Ragi is one of the crops this tribe grow in their farms on hill slops. The ragi and other millets are part of their everyday food.
